scope: Bounded construction screening, not full acceptance
interpretation: Combined failure-first and victim-shape retries were actually exercised, rather than inferred from individual failures. None produced a candidate to qualify. This does not prove geometric infeasibility. The earlier order-3 combined candidate constructed but failed the wiring-length quality budget; no gate was waived.
budget_semantics: The ratsnest cross budget is a placement-quality proxy: cross_k * sqrt(board area) * subsystem count (ratsnest_gate.cpp), not a physical electrical infeasibility proof. Reducing the wiring proxy without sacrificing physical or electrical constraints remains required.
timing_limitations: Instrumented, single-run screening with concurrent processes; no speedup comparison.
